title: Terms on Which Snowsports School Credit May Be Spent
content:
School credit is spent against school charges on the household account and is not paid out. These are the Snowsports School terms on which it is applied.

## Validity

The following clause is **no longer in force**: "School credit is applied only when it is applied no later than its validity period counted in calendar days from the day the credit was issued." It is carried here only so that no reader applies it, the current basis for how long credit counts having replaced it.

Calendar days are counted forward from the anchor date, the anchor date itself counting as day zero, every day of the week counting alike, and a calendar day is never mixed with a full 24-hour period; where the resulting boundary falls on a date that does not exist in the target month, the last day of that month is used.

## Smallest application and part payment

A single application must be at least the product's minimum, and credit may be applied to part of a charge, leaving the remainder to be paid.

## State of the booking

School credit is applied only while the booking record it sits on has not reached the cancelled, missed or closed state. The state is read from the booking record, matched by the booking reference, before the credit is applied; in the asked-for, waiting, firm, under-way and delivered states the credit may be applied.

## Where credit may be spent

Credit issued on one booking may be applied to any school booking on the same household account, but never to another household, never to lift tickets, lodging or retail, and never to cash.

## Order in which entries are spent

Where several credit entries sit on one household account, the entry closest to running out is applied first.

## The terms put as a set of readings

| Situation | Reading |
| --- | --- |
| credit standing below the product's smallest application, offered against a school charge | the application is not made |
| credit standing at exactly the product's smallest application | the application is made |
| credit standing above the charge it is offered against | the credit is applied to part of the charge, and the rest of the credit stays standing |
| credit standing below the charge | the credit is applied and the remainder of the charge is paid |
| credit issued on one school booking, offered against a school charge on another booking of the same household account | the application is made |
| credit offered against a lodging folio or a lift ticket | the application is not made |
| two credit entries standing, one closer to running out than the other | the entry closer to running out is applied first |

The smallest applications and the credit validity periods these terms speak of are published product by product on the Snowsports School tariff.

superseded_clauses: School credit is applied only when it is applied no later than its validity period counted in calendar days from the day the credit was issued.
